description: This PHP source file generates a web page interface for displaying and managing voice quality metrics on a gateway device. The file includes HTML, JavaScript, and PHP code components that handle data retrieval, presentation, and user interactions concerning voice call quality statistics, including displaying call data, clearing statistics, and updating the interface dynamically.

methods.name: DmExtGetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Retrieves an array of string parameters from a device management data model rooted at a specified object.

methods.name: getInstanceIds
methods.description: Obtains a list of instance IDs for a given device model path.
